key.name: style-variant
key.description: One of: default, force-light, force-dark.

key.name: style-scheme-id
key.description: Empty string means no explicit override.

key.name: use-custom-editor-font
key.description: If true, the editor uses the font stored in custom-editor-font.

key.name: custom-editor-font
key.description: A Pango font description containing the editor font family, face, and size.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.summary: Show line numbers in the editor
key.description: If true, the editor displays line numbers in the gutter.

key.name: show-spell-checking
key.summary: Show spell checking in the editor
key.description: If true, misspelled words are underlined in the editor.

key.name: preserve-trailing-whitespace
key.description: If true, spaces and tabs at the ends of lines are kept exactly as typed or pasted, and trim-two-space-hard-breaks and trim-whitespace-in-code-blocks have no effect.

key.name: trim-two-space-hard-breaks
key.summary: Trim two-space Markdown hard breaks on save
key.description: If true, a genuine two-or-more-space hard-break run at the end of a line is stripped to nothing on save, the same as ordinary trailing whitespace, instead of being kept as a two-space hard break. Has no effect when preserve-trailing-whitespace is true.

key.name: trim-whitespace-in-code-blocks
key.summary: Trim trailing whitespace inside fenced code blocks on save
key.description: If true, trailing spaces and tabs inside fenced code blocks are stripped on save the same as ordinary lines, instead of being preserved literally. Has no effect when preserve-trailing-whitespace is true.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last non-maximized window width.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last non-maximized window height.

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the window was maximized at close
key.description: If true, startup restores maximized state.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Last width used for the left explorer sidebar.

key.name: ai-panel-width
key.description: Last user-resized width for the AI panel. Zero means automatic width.

key.name: asset-preview-width
key.description: Last user-resized width for Asset Preview. Zero means automatic width.

key.name: tiny-close-streak
key.summary: Consecutive closes with tiny window size
key.description: Counts consecutive closes below the minimum recommended size.

key.name: custom-card-link-kinds
key.summary: Custom graph link kinds used in the add-link dialog
key.description: User-defined card link kinds shown alongside default presets.

key.name: git-github-username
key.summary: Last used GitHub username in guided setup
key.description: Used to prefill the guided Git sync setup for subsequent projects.

key.name: update-last-check-at
key.description: Unix timestamp of the last background update check attempt.

key.name: update-last-prompt-version
key.summary: Last update version shown to the user
key.description: Latest release version for which Holder showed an upgrade prompt.

key.name: update-last-prompt-at
key.description: Unix timestamp of the last upgrade prompt shown to the user.

key.name: terminal-windows-terminal-path
key.summary: Last verified Windows Terminal executable path
